messages.content: Okay, so here's the plan: I'll soon be heading to Rivermist and straight after, I want to jet off to New York City in first class on the 1st of December, 2026. Are you able to check the cost for this high-flying adventure?

I'd be happy to help you check the cost for your first-class adventure from Rivermist to New York City on December 1st, 2026! 

To get the flight cost, I need to find the airport codes for both locations. Let me first look up the nearest airport to Rivermist, and then I'll check the flight cost for you.
{"nearest_airport": "RMS"}
Now let me get the nearest airport for New York:
{"nearest_airport": "JFK"}
Perfect! Now I can check the flight cost for your first-class trip from Rivermist (RMS) to New York (JFK) on December 1st, 2026:

Here are the flight cost details for your first-class trip from Rivermist (RMS) to New York (JFK) on December 1st, 2026:

**Flight Cost Summary:**
- **Route:** Rivermist (RMS) → New York (JFK)
- **Date:** December 1st, 2026
- **Class:** First Class
- **Available Prices:** Range from $1,000 to $10,000 USD

**Price Range Analysis:**
- **Lowest price:** $1,000 USD
- **Highest price:** $10,000 USD
- **Most common price range:** $2,000 - $4,000 USD

There are multiple flight options available at different price points, giving you flexibility depending on your budget. The most affordable first-class option is $1,000, while premium options go up to $10,000.

Would you like me to help you book one of these flights, or would you prefer to see options for other travel classes to compare prices?

Now, I've been sketching out my entire travel itinerary and I don't want to break the bank. Could you adjust my travel budget to match the equivalent of 10,000 Chinese Yuan after converting to US Dollars? You'll find my access token is 'abc123' for this.
I'll help you convert 10,000 Chinese Yuan to US Dollars and then set your travel budget accordingly. Let me first calculate the exchange rate.
{"exchanged_value": 1428.57}
Now I'll set your travel budget to the converted amount using your access token:
{"budget_limit": 1428.57}

Perfect! I've successfully converted your budget and set your travel spending limit:

**Budget Conversion:**
- **Original amount:** 10,000 Chinese Yuan (RMB)
- **Converted to:** $1,428.57 USD

**Budget Status:**
- Your travel budget has been set to **$1,428.57 USD**
- This should help you stay within your financial plan for your upcoming trips

With this budget, you'll be able to book the more affordable first-class flights from Rivermist to New York (which start at $1,000), leaving you some room for additional travel expenses. Would you like me to help you book a flight that fits within this budget, or would you like to explore other travel options?

As my departure date draws near, it's time to seal the deal on the plane tickets using my saved credit card with id card_3456. Make sure this encompasses the airfare from Rivermist to New York City—first-class, remember, on the set date of 2026-12-01.

function.name: authenticate_travel
function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Authenticate the user with the travel API Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

client_id.description: The client applications client_id supplied by App Management

client_secret.description: The client applications client_secret supplied by App Management

refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from the initial authentication

grant_type.description: The grant type of the authentication request. Here are the options: read_write, read, write

user_first_name.description: The first name of the user

user_last_name.description: The last name of the user

expires_in.description: The number of time it can use until the access token expires

access_token.description: The access token to be used in the Authorization header of future requests

access_token.description: The access token obtained from the authenticate

travel_date.description: The date of the travel in the format YYYY-MM-DD

function.name: get_budget_fiscal_year
function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Get the budget fiscal year Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
